items.title: Show HN: Bringing the alternative to remove.bg that are privacy and AI-first
items.raw_excerpt:
I built I Hate Background (IHB) after noticing that most background-removal tools send every image to external servers.
IHB takes the opposite path: it runs the entire segmentation pipeline locally in the browser, using a WebAssembly/WebGPU-optimized AI model. No uploads, no tracking, no logging. Tech bits:
• Browser: WebGPU + ONNX runtime for real-time inference
• Frontend: ~12s average removal on mid-range hardware
• Privacy: Zero data leaves the device Thanks to Hugging Face and Transformers.js' team for support this. Would love feedback on model performance, UX, and design.

items.title: Show HN: Where Was I? – AI summaries for when you forget your book's plot
items.raw_excerpt:
I have ADHD and a 200+ book TBR pile. The problem is I keep putting down complex novels, then picking them up three weeks later with absolutely no memory of who these characters are or why they're arguing about inheritance law. So I built Where Was I? Upload a PDF or EPUB, tell it what page you're on, and it generates a spoiler-free summary of everything up to that point. Live: https://app.wherewasi.co.uk (no signup required - just upload and go) The system uses RAG with semantic chunking that follows narrative structure rather than arbitrary page breaks. It extracts plot points using MMR and contextual relevance scoring, then generates summaries that avoid spoiling anything beyond your current page. Tech stack:

items.title: Show HN: AI Domain Data Standard – Self-Hosted, DNS-Based Identity for AI
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN! I built the AI Domain Data Standard (AIDD), an open, vendor-neutral way for any domain to publish canonical identity data that AI systems can read without relying on third-party aggregators. https://github.com/ai-domain-data/spec/ The idea: use infrastructure you already control (DNS + HTTPS) to publish one small JSON document and let assistants consume it directly. Why: AI models routinely misinterpret websites because “who we are” is scattered across schema.org fragments, social profiles, JSON-LD, and other unstructured mediums. AIDD gives every domain a single, self-hosted source of truth. You publish the same JSON payload in two places: https:///.well-known/domain-profile.json _ai. TXT = ai-json= (standard Base64, ≤255-character segments) v0.1 schema (intentionally minimal): { "

excerpt_i18n.en: Today, we stand at a new turning point, which is not just a technological shift but also a cognitive watershed. At the 2025 China SaaS Conference hosted by Cuidui Hui, Cui Qiang, founder and CEO of Cuidui Hui, outlined the "N turning points" for Chinese enterprise software: the AI turning point redefines productivity through software; the globalization turning point prompts Chinese companies to rethink global competitiveness; and the profitability turning point brings businesses back to the essence of operations. Since the "SaaS inaugural year" of 2015, a decade-long digital journey has witnessed rapid technological evolution from cloud computing and big data to artificial intelligence. Now, the wave of AI technologies, represented by large models, is surging forward, powerfully driving the SaaS industry into a new era of intelligence. Today, the SaaS industry stands at a historic "turning point" in China's To B software sector. This is not merely a temporal milestone but a profound paradigm shift that will reshape the industry's future landscape. At the conference, Leifeng Net heard discussions on sustainable growth paths for Chinese SaaS and enterprise software. The "N turning points" toward maturity for Chinese enterprise software: Over the past decade, Chinese SaaS has evolved from foundational exploration of "starting from scratch" to a transformation from "pursuing speed" to "pursuing stability." In this phase, SaaS companies faced opportunities and challenges in rapid expansion, market development, and embracing technological waves. excerpt_i18n.en:
On November 13, Baidu World 2025 was held in Beijing. At the event, Baidu Wenku and Baidu Wangpan officially launched GenFlow 3.0, which has over 20 million active users and has become the "world's largest general-purpose intelligent agent." Based on GenFlow 3.0, Baidu Wenku and Wangpan announced comprehensive upgrades and revealed their overseas progress for the first time. Baidu Wenku introduced the all-in-one AI learning and office platform "Oreate" overseas, while Baidu Wangpan was globally launched in September this year. After two years of restructuring, Baidu Wenku and Wangpan have become "super apps" with global influence, helping every user become a "super individual." 

GenFlow 3.0 was newly released, featuring two leading intelligent agents: Office Agent and GenX Agent. Following the launch of GenFlow 2.0 in August, Wenku and Wangpan completed the rapid iteration to GenFlow 3.0 in just over two months. As the world's first full-stack general-purpose intelligent agent, it boasts more powerful universal multimodal capabilities, breaking through limitations in content modalities, creative approaches, and expression interactions, fully enabling the input, processing, and output of all-modal content. Currently, GenFlow 3.0 is officially available across all platforms of Wenku and Wangpan.

Reportedly, GenFlow 3.0 adopts a centralized native Multi-Agent architecture, builds contextual engineering based on industry knowledge graphs, and has independently developed a "multimodal fusion editor," creating industry-leading specialized technical capabilities. GenFlow 3.0 upgrade.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 13 de noviembre se celebró en Pekín el Baidu World 2025. Durante el evento, Baidu Wenku y Baidu Wangpan lanzaron oficialmente GenFlow 3.0, que cuenta con más de 20 millones de usuarios activos y se ha convertido en el "agente de inteligencia general más grande del mundo". Basado en GenFlow 3.0, Baidu Wenku y Wangpan anunciaron una renovación integral y revelaron por primera vez sus avances en expansión internacional. Baidu Wenku lanzó en el extranjero la plataforma integral de aprendizaje y trabajo con IA "Oreate", mientras que Baidu Wangpan se lanzó globalmente en septiembre de este año. Tras dos años de reestructuración, Baidu Wenku y Wangpan se han convertido en "superaplicaciones" con influencia global, ayudando a cada usuario a convertirse en un "superindividuo". GenFlow 3.0.
